basics.name: Yu Zhang
basics.label: PhD Researcher and Research Assistant
basics.summary: PhD researcher in Chemical and Process Engineering at the University of Surrey, working at the interface of AI, digital twins and data-driven engineering. Research spans data-efficient formulation and drug-delivery design, uncertainty-aware modelling, scientific evidence extraction and reproducible machine learning with real-world clinical data.

work.name: University of Surrey
work.summary: Work with Dr Xilu Wang on reproducible machine-learning workflows for real-world clinical data in assisted reproduction and IVF.
highlights: Define clinically meaningful outcomes and construct analysis-ready features from heterogeneous, longitudinal treatment records.
Address incomplete records and outcome availability when preparing data for patient-level outcome modelling.
Design patient-aware and time-aware validation to reduce information leakage and assess model generalisation.
Maintain auditable workflows with attention to confidentiality, data provenance and reproducibility.

work.name: University of Surrey
work.position: PhD Researcher — Machine Learning and Digital-Twin Modelling
work.summary: Data-efficient modelling and experimental decision-making for pharmaceutical formulation and drug delivery.
highlights: Develop Gaussian-process surrogate models, Bayesian optimisation and active-learning workflows for adaptive and multi-objective experimental design.
Model drug-release and permeation behaviour using domain-knowledge-constrained symbolic regression and temporal prediction from partial experimental trajectories.
Develop reproducible LLM-enabled workflows for scientific evidence extraction and dataset construction.

work.name: University of Surrey
work.summary: Teaching support across engineering systems, science principles and advanced pharmaceutical formulations.

work.name: National Key R&D Programme of China project
work.position: Research Assistant — Intelligent Monitoring of Electric Submersible Pump Systems
work.summary: Data-driven condition monitoring, fault classification and early warning from multivariate operational and process data.
highlights: Applied PCA/SFA, regression, clustering and SVM methods to operational sensor and process data.
Implemented Python-based analytical software for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis.

work.name: China University of Petroleum - Beijing
work.position: Research Assistant — Data-Driven Reservoir Simulation Analysis
work.summary: Data-driven analysis of numerical reservoir-simulation outputs.
highlights: Used PCA/MPCA, Hotelling's T², SPE and self-organising maps to extract spatial and temporal features.
Classified dominant flow regimes from simulation outputs.

work.name: External client project
work.position: Technical Lead — Big Data AI Analysis System for Shale Gas Trading Market
work.summary: Python software for energy-market data collection, analysis and visualisation.
highlights: Built automated collection and analysis of real-time and historical market data.
Delivered executable software to an external client.
